surface_mechanism_description: NH3 facilitates the decomposition of Ta(OC2H5)5. Tantalum oxide films were deposited by ALD using Ta(OC2H5)5 and NH3 on the Si substrate at 250-275 °C. As-deposited films were amorphous and contained nitrogen and carbon impurities. Annealing in oxygen atmosphere crystallized the films and decreased the impurities.
